dataset.name: iris
dataset.preprocessing: stratified split; min-max (and for Breast Cancer standardization+PCA) fitted on train only

noise_model.placement: independent single-qubit depolarizing channel on each qubit touched by RY, RZ, CNOT (encoding included, H excluded)
noise_model.simulation: exact density matrix; shots are independent binomial samples
noise_model.scope: simulator sensitivity model; not a hardware calibration

classical_quantum_boundary: Circuits produce Z expectations (exact or from shots); the host computes losses, parameter-shift combinations or reconstructions, optimizer updates, validation checkpointing and test metrics. This is the standard variational (hybrid) execution model for current hardware.

logistic_regression.features: same normalized features as the QCNN
